message: Oh, God, you have no IDEA. Charlie, Matt, Bradley, and I just deleted HUNDREDS of spam user accounts. Charlie then installed a captcha so that users would have to do a simple math problem in order to be able to create a new account. BUT, something was wrong with the module, because it kept telling people they had the wrong answer to the problems (these were 8 + 2 type problems). So we had to disable the module for the time being.
